usedFor: Contacts+ holds your people, and Google Drive gets a folder for each one when “Create Folder” follows “Contact Is Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Is Created” in Contacts+, then “Create Folder” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Every new contact gets a folder in Google Drive, ready for contracts and files.

watchOut: “Create Folder” takes an optional parent folder, so set one or every folder lands at the top of Google Drive.
